# Architecture

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

### Style

Layered Laravel monolith (Controller → FormRequest → Service → Eloquent → Resource) rendering a single Inertia v3 SPA, with a framework-free TypeScript core (`resources/js/canvas/`, `resources/js/prancheta/`) that the Vue layer only binds to.

### Directory layout

```
app/
  Actions/Fortify/        CreateNewUser, ResetUserPassword — Fortify hooks
  Concerns/               HasActiveScope, ReadOnlyAtRuntime, Password/ProfileValidationRules
  Http/Controllers/       BoardController (invokable, Inertia), TrainingSessionController (JSON), Settings/{Profile,Security}
  Http/Middleware/        HandleAppearance, HandleInertiaRequests (shared props: name, auth.user, sidebarOpen)
  Http/Requests/          TrainingSessionStore/UpdateRequest + Settings/* — all payload rules live here
  Http/Resources/         10 JsonResource classes = the wire shape of session + catalog
  Http/Responses/         LogoutResponse (Fortify contract override)
  Models/                 14 models (12 read-only catalog + User + TrainingSession) + Scopes/
  Policies/               TrainingSessionPolicy — owner checks only
  Providers/              AppServiceProvider (owner-scoped route binding, CarbonImmutable, Password defaults), FortifyServiceProvider
  Services/               CatalogService, CurrentSessionResolver, SessionCreator, SessionStateWriter
bootstrap/app.php         middleware stack, /up health, redirectUsersTo('/prancheta'), JSON exceptions for api/*
config/                   12 files; fortify.php holds home=/prancheta and the enabled feature list
database/
  factories/              14 factories (one per model)
  migrations/             18 files — 5 framework/auth + 13 domain tables
  seeders/                CatalogSeeder + 11 child seeders; seeders/data/problems.php = 14 statements as data
resources/
  css/                    app.css (shadcn/Tailwind theme) + prancheta.css (board tokens under `sd-` prefix)
  js/canvas/              framework-free diagram engine: nodes, edges, geometry, layout, view, undo, order, legend, svg
  js/prancheta/           framework-free board logic: session store, autosave, clock, roteiro, estimate, problems, sessions, theme
  js/components/prancheta/ 33 Vue components binding the two TS cores to the DOM
  js/components/ui/       shadcn-vue / reka-ui primitives (ESLint-ignored)
  js/composables/         useAutosave, useStageInteraction, useClock, useLegend, useTheme, useToast, …
  js/pages/               Inertia pages: Board.vue, Dashboard.vue, Welcome.vue, auth/*, settings/*
  js/{actions,routes,wayfinder}/ Wayfinder build artifacts (gitignored, ESLint-ignored)
  views/app.blade.php     sole Blade file — the Inertia root layout
routes/                   web.php (home, board, dashboard, /api/sessions*), settings.php, console.php
tests/                    Pest suite: Pest.php helpers + Feature/{Auth,Frontend,Migrations,Models,Seeders,Sessions,Settings} + Unit
```

### Layer responsibilities

| Layer | Owns | Does NOT own |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `routes/` | URI, name, middleware group (`auth`, `throttle:6,1`, `RequirePassword`). | Any logic; every board/session route delegates to a controller. |
| `app/Http/Controllers/` | `Gate::authorize` per action, service invocation, HTTP status. | Validation (FormRequests), persistence (Services), payload shaping (Resources). |
| `app/Http/Requests/` | `prepareForValidation` normalization, `Rule::in` against catalog slugs, hard limits (200 nodes / 400 edges / 60-char label / 5000-char notes). | `user_id` — never in the rules, never accepted from the client. |
| `app/Services/` | Catalog assembly, current-session derivation, session birth, transactional autosave write. | Views, redirects, flash messages, `request()`/`session()`/`auth()` access — values are passed in. |
| `app/Models/` | Schema mapping, casts, relationships, `ownedBy`/`active` scopes, `OrderByPosition` global scopes, runtime read-only guard. | Business orchestration. |
| `app/Http/Resources/` | Wire shape. `TrainingSessionResource` is `#[PreserveKeys]` so the `checks` map keeps its `checklist_items.id` keys; it never emits `user_id`. | Queries — `CatalogService` eager-loads before resolving. |
| `resources/js/canvas/` | Geometry, hit shapes, snap, undo stack, explicit connection order, derived legend, SVG serialization. | Vue, Inertia, `document`, `window` — swept by `tests/Feature/Frontend/CanvasEngineTest.php`. |
| `resources/js/prancheta/` | Session store + dirty signature, autosave timing, weighted clock, roteiro, estimate arithmetic, export naming. | DOM access and any hardcoded catalog values — phases, durations, modes all arrive from the server. |
| `resources/js/components/prancheta/` | Binding, measuring, event wiring, `data-testid` contract. | Business logic (kept server-side per `CLAUDE.md`). |
| `database/seeders/` | The entire domain catalog as versioned, idempotent `upsert` data keyed by slug / minutes / `(phase_id, position)`. | Runtime writes — `ReadOnlyAtRuntime` throws outside console. |

### External integration points

| System | Client/config | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| MySQL 8 | `config/database.php`, `.env.example` `DB_CONNECTION=mysql`, `docker-compose.yml` service `mysql:8.0` volume `sail-mysql` | Dev/prod store. `phpunit.xml` forces `sqlite` `:memory:` for tests. |
| Laravel Fortify | `config/fortify.php` (`guard: web`, `home: /prancheta`, `middleware: ['web']`) | 36 vendor routes (`php artisan route:list --only-vendor`): login, register, email verify, 2FA, passkeys. Password reset absent by design. |
| WebAuthn / passkeys | `@laravel/passkeys ^0.2.0` + `.well-known/passkey-endpoints` in `routes/settings.php` | Endpoint doc returns `enroll`/`manage` pointing at `security.edit`. |
| Mail transport | `MAIL_MAILER=log` (`.env.example`), `array` in `phpunit.xml` | Only consumer is Fortify email verification. |
| Vite dev/build | `vite.config.ts` plugins: `laravel`, `inertia()`, `tailwindcss()`, `vue()`, `wayfinder({formVariants:true})` | Wayfinder emits the TS helpers `sessionTransport.ts` imports. |
| Health probe | `bootstrap/app.php` `health: '/up'` | Framework-provided endpoint, no custom checks. |

### Macro flow: board load → draw → autosave

```
  Browser                Laravel                         MySQL
  -------                -------                         -----
  GET /prancheta ----->  auth middleware
                         BoardController::__invoke
                           CurrentSessionResolver ----->  SELECT training_sessions
                           |  none? SessionCreator ---->  INSERT training_sessions
                           CatalogService::payload ---->  SELECT 7 catalog tables
                         Inertia::render('Board')
  <---- {session, catalog}

  Board.vue
    +-- CanvasEngine (canvas/)      nodes, edges, geometry, undo
    +-- SessionStore (prancheta/)   checks, notes, estimate, clock
          |
          | every change -> Autosave.touch()
          v
     +----------------------------------------+
     | 800ms  -> localStorage mirror          |
     | 3000ms -> PUT /api/sessions/{id}       |
     | 15000ms ceiling (clock ticks each 1s)  |
     +----------------------------------------+
                          |
  PUT /api/sessions/{id} ->  Route::bind ownedBy(user)  --> 404 if not owner
                             Gate::authorize('update')  --> 403 if not owner
                             TrainingSessionUpdateRequest (422 on limits)
                             SessionStateWriter::write   --> DB::transaction UPDATE
  <---- {"id":…, "updated_at":…}

  Failure paths (resources/js/prancheta/autosave.ts):
    429 -> wait Retry-After (default 20s), label "aguardando para salvar"
    other/network(0) -> backoff 3s x2^n capped 48s, session stays dirty
    cached serverUpdatedAt newer -> label "versão mais nova na nuvem", no overwrite
```

### Macro flow: SVG export (no server round trip)

```
  Board.vue -> useTheme().vars (SvgPalette: CSS token -> resolved color)
            -> canvas/svg.ts   (same geometry module the stage renders with)
            -> prancheta/export.ts (file name)
            -> lib/downloadFile.ts (the only DOM step)
            -> file on disk
```
